policy: Donor files were read at their pinned commits in the local mirrors (tools/mirrors.py), as data; nothing was run. Ideas only, in westack's own words; no donor text is copied (skills/westack/provenance/RIGHTS.md). The component classification is skills/westack/provenance/absorption.json (gbrain.search.*, gbrain.chunking, gbrain.sync, gbrain.schema, gbrain.keyword-only-mode, gbrain.doctor, gstack.gbrain.sync-orchestrator).

usefulness_legend.strong: shaped the skill's structure or its numbers
usefulness_legend.useful: added a rule or a check

donors.system: gbrain keyword search, chunking, sync and doctor

sources.read: searched for the sources, pages, chunks and links tables and the chunker version
header and constants: RRF k 60, fusion then boosts, token budget
from the 2026-11-04 inventory: one chunk per symbol with a token cap
from the 2026-11-04 inventory: watermark, failure ledger, renames, soft deletes
from the 2026-11-04 inventory: index health report

taken.mechanism: Sources, pages, chunks and links tables with content hashes and a chunker version whose change re-walks every file.
Weighted keyword search with title and symbol fields above body text, fused by reciprocal rank (k 60) with a title arm, then title, recency and backlink boosts, inside token budgets.
One chunk per code symbol with a token cap, Markdown heading chunks, and a word-window fallback.
A watermark never advanced on a partial run, a failure list the user can acknowledge, rename identity by content and soft deletes.
A keyword-only mode as a first-class default, and a doctor that reports index health.

rejected: Postgres, PGLite and the hosted engines: Python's sqlite3 serves one user on one machine.
Embeddings, rerankers and synopses at search time: opt-in local extensions wait for S18; the paid ones are excluded.
Running git for the file list and the delta: westack's helpers run no command, so the index reads .git files and detects renames by content.

sources.read: header (lines 1-30) and the stage result type: lock, stale takeover after 5 minutes, tmp-and-rename state, OK/WARN/ERR
hashed; its guidance-block steps wait for S17

taken.mechanism: A lock file with a stale takeover after five minutes, released in a finally block.
A state file written to a temporary file and renamed into place, and an OK, WARN or ERR verdict for each run.

rejected: Signal traps: Python's finally covers the release on an interrupt; a killed process leaves a lock the next run takes over.
The memory-ingest and artifact stages: gstack's own state, not an index of the repository.

taken.mechanism: A context pack for one symbol filled to a token budget, and the files changed since a watermark.

rejected: Tree-sitter edge extraction by default: Python's ast and call patterns run with the standard library; tree-sitter is S18's opt-in.
Serving these as MCP verbs: S18's opt-in.

donors.system: gstack gbrain repository policy and sync guidance block

sources.read: from the 2026-11-04 inventory: tiers, URL normalisation, a quarantined corrupt file, and lines 34-36 where read-only is not enforced
from the 2026-11-04 inventory: the guidance block written after a put-search-delete round trip and removed when it fails

taken.mechanism: Per-repository read-write, read-only and deny tiers keyed by a normalised remote URL, with a corrupt policy file moved aside.
taken.where: scripts/codeindex.py load_policy, tier_for, enforce, set_tier; references/governance.md

taken.mechanism: A marked search-guidance block in the instruction file, written only after a put-search-delete round trip within three tries and removed when the round trip fails.

rejected: Unenforced read-only: westack's helper refuses build, update and the ping under read-only, and everything under deny.
Treating a corrupt policy as empty: westack fails closed (read-only) until the file is restored or replaced.
Writing the block as part of every sync: here it is its own command, a dry run unless the user grants the instruction-file edit.

donors.system: gbrain local embeddings, secret scan and MCP server

from the 2026-11-04 inventory: secrets scanned before content leaves

taken.mechanism: A vector arm through a local embedding endpoint, fused by rank with the keyword arms, off by default.
A secret scan of everything that would leave the machine, refusing the whole export on one finding.
The read verbs served over MCP stdio, write verbs left out.

rejected: The local reranker: not built in S18, no acceptance check covers it.
Write verbs over MCP: index writes stay on the command line, under the trust tier.

taken.mechanism: Sharing derived state through a private git repository as sorted JSONL, scanned for secrets first, merged by key.

rejected: Running git from the script: the agent runs git under the user's grant; the script only exports and imports.
Union merge of markdown: the index exports no markdown state.
